qualification: component nginx+actual authority library; trusted synthetic ALLOW fixture
denominator: scenario groups in one Rust pilot process, not Rust test-harness tests; HEAD-and-204 includes two HTTP behaviors; concurrent-service group accounts 32 requests
consumer_rules: Never execute arbitrary contract strings: use fixed Rust Docker subcommands with a validated owned project and source-bound local image tag.
Build source_revision must equal the exact checkout commit; source_manifest and cargo_lock_sha256 must equal the owner's frozen input hashes.
Success requires process exit0, exactly one report JSON object, unique complete required group IDs, result=passed on each, zero failed/ignored/not_run, and full_product_qualified=false.
Record the built/run image ID and verify it remains unchanged; a mutable tag or a previous green report alone is insufficient.
Cleanup runs even after build/run/report failure, removes only the unique owned project, and its failure cannot become passed.
Public output is sanitized summary/static diagnostics/hash only; no credential readiness, cookies, request bodies or private IPC traces.
A failed process may have no success JSON: preserve its exit and static error, record unknown/unreached groups honestly, never infer zero failures.
